[ THE PROBLEM ]

FINANCIAL DECISIONS DEMAND CONTEXT.

Standard EMI calculators isolate each purchase: they tell you how much a monthly payment will cost in a vacuum, but ignore existing debt commitments, dependants, emergency buffers, or upcoming milestones.

Buy or Wait? remembers your full household picture securely. When considering an expensive purchase or new loan, it runs a multi-dimensional stress test against your actual runway to return an honest Buy, Wait, or Reject verdict.

[ HOW IT WORKS ]

PROFILE TO EXPLAINABLE VERDICT.

01 / PROFILE

PERSIST CONTEXT

Build a household balance sheet covering monthly income stability, fixed obligations, liquid reserves, and family dependants.

02 / SIMULATE

STRESS-TEST PURCHASE

Model outright cash or EMI debt impact against 4 stress scenarios over a 60-month forecast horizon.

03 / EVALUATE

FIVE WEIGHTED SIGNALS

Compute Debt-to-Income (DTI), liquidity decay, emergency months coverage, dependency risk, and savings velocity.

04 / REPORT

SAVE DECISION AUDIT

Generate an explainable resilience report with concrete recommendations, stored privately in the user's account history.

[ SYSTEM ]

WHAT IS USED.

BACKEND

FASTAPI + PYTHON

High-performance REST API with Decimal-safe financial arithmetic, Pydantic validation, and SQLite / PostgreSQL persistence.

SECURITY

AUTHENTICATED DATA ISOLATION

PBKDF2-SHA256 password hashing (310,000 rounds), signed HTTP-only cookies, SameSite enforcement, and CSP headers.

INFRASTRUCTURE

DOCKER + VERCEL / RENDER

Containerized microservice packaging with automated CI testing and zero external credit bureau dependencies.

[ OUTCOME ]

PRACTICAL VALUE OVER VANITY.

01

ZERO EXTERNAL BANK APIS

User privacy is preserved. No credit bureau queries or invasive open-banking trackers are ever required.

02

DYNAMIC DEBT WORKSPACE

Track active loans with automatic recalculation of resilience as principal balances approach completion.

03

DECISION COMPARISON

Compare multiple purchase scenarios side-by-side to understand trade-offs before signing loan paperwork.
